[[File:ArcadeOmicron.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A scenic replicator being used in a side room at the [[Arcade Omicron]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].]]
The '''scenic replicator''' was a device that could create the illusion of a variety of planets for interested customers. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]], a scenic replicator was a common site in the [[Arcade Omicron]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. The device would be used in small side rooms that branched off of the cantina's main hall. The side rooms would then be transformed into the image of the desired planet through the use of [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] technology. Among the many scenes present on the replicator were the [[swuvehorn]] clubs of [[Fegorosk IV]], the [[Geyser/Legends|ice geysers]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], the forests of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the mountains of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], the desert wastes of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and the tropical seashores of [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]].<ref name="DH">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref>
